name: Sakurai Yuuki
source: In a car accident 10 years ago, she lost her parents and got a serious mental scar. She underwent treatments and nowadays, she is able to live normally (she lives with Haruyoshi and Sachiko). Yuuki has an extreme brother-complex and is really close to Kaede.
